16.t: Working with data: carbon dioxide per passenger
q: Which way of travelling releases the most CO₂ per passenger?
Calculate how many times more CO₂ a plane trip releases than a coach.
Explain why a car with 4 people has a quarter of the CO₂ per person.
The car burns about the same fuel whatever the load, so the CO₂ is shared among four.
Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City is about 1600 km. Evaluate train against plane for this trip.
Train: about a quarter of the CO₂ per person but takes about 30 hours; plane about 2 hours. A fair answer weighs time, cost and emissions.
